rules.text: Natural leader, manages and motivates people, becomes popular without trying; heads teams/organisations/business

source.quote: People with Destiny Number (DN) 1 are natural leaders.

rules.say: You are a natural leader who manages and motivates people and becomes popular without trying. You can head teams, organisations or a business.

rules.text: Farsighted, wise decisions, prompt; "uncertain and unexpected monetary gains"; patience, organisation, persistence

source.quote: They also enjoy uncertain and unexpected monetary gains.

rules.say: You are farsighted and make wise, prompt decisions, and you may enjoy unexpected money gains. Patience, organisation and persistence serve you well.

rules.text: Worldly accomplishments, royal lifestyle; if spiritually inclined becomes a great spiritual leader; logical; givers who help others

source.quote: if a person with this destiny number gets spiritually inclined, they end up being a great spiritual leader

rules.say: You can achieve worldly success and a royal lifestyle, and if you turn spiritual, you can become a great spiritual leader. You are logical and a giver who helps others.

rules.text: Remedy/advice: cultivate commitment and punctuality

source.quote: Destiny Number 1 demands commitment and punctuality - this can be used as a remedy

rules.say: Commitment and punctuality are your remedy, so build them into your daily life.

rules.text: Disappointment, low phases, setbacks when Sun is weak; develop patience

source.quote: during the period when Sun is weak like in October, November, and December

rules.condition: destiny = 1 AND month in {Oct, Nov, Dec}
rules.say: This is a weaker phase as the Sun is weak, and it can bring disappointment, low moods and setbacks. Be patient through it.

rules.text: Moon: emotions, attractiveness, rapid change; family is everything; emotional and sensitive; strong domestic ties; peace-lover; self-respect, mannerly

source.quote: People with DN as 2 are family-oriented and love their families.

rules.say: Ruled by the Moon, you are emotional, sensitive and peace-loving, and family is everything to you. You have strong home ties, self-respect and good manners.

rules.text: Swings in life; opportunities slip away when success is in sight

source.quote: experiencing opportunities pass them right by when success is within sight

rules.say: Your life can see swings, and opportunities may slip away just when success is in sight.

rules.text: Love and support of women (family, work, women in high positions); righteous mother; marries attractive woman; loves plants, redecorating; first serious relationship/marriage may not last

source.quote: Their first serious relationship or marriage might not last long.

rules.say: For men: you tend to have the love and support of women at home and at work, though a first serious relationship or marriage may not last long.

rules.text: Very attractive, dresses well; devoted to partner; over-emotional in relationships; strong and resilient; blamed for things not done

source.quote: they would cry but they are resilient in taking care of themselves

rules.say: For women: you are devoted to your partner and can get over-emotional in relationships, yet you are strong and resilient, though sometimes blamed for things you did not do.

rules.text: Rule the arts (performers, painters, actors, singers, poets, hosts, dancers); helplessness after setbacks, insecurity in romance; heartbreak commonly observed

source.quote: When it comes to art, people with Destiny number 2 are known to rule that space.

rules.say: You can shine in the arts as a performer, painter, actor, singer, poet, host or dancer. Setbacks can leave you feeling helpless, and you may feel insecure in romance and face heartbreak.

rules.text: Good doctors, psychologists, therapists, marriage counsellors, healing fields; after 35 inclined to occult/religion

source.quote: Past the age of 35, they may develop a deep inclination toward the occult sciences

rules.say: You can do well as a doctor, psychologist, therapist, marriage counsellor or in healing work. After 35, you may feel drawn to the occult or religion.

rules.text: Remedy/advice: acknowledge and respect others' emotions

source.quote: acknowledging others' emotions and respecting them will lead to miracles

rules.say: Acknowledge and respect others' emotions; this can work miracles for you.

rules.text: Jupiter, teacher; knowledge and value addition; noticed in any group; loves learning and sharing; advisor; creative, intuitive, storyteller, loves travel

source.quote: Destiny number 3 represents knowledge and value addition.

rules.say: Ruled by Jupiter, the teacher, you love learning and sharing knowledge and get noticed in any group. Creative and intuitive, you make a good advisor and storyteller, and love travel.

rules.text: Hard work brings excess pressure, stress, anxiety -> family, health, relationship issues; knowledge can turn into show-off

source.quote: excessive work pressure resulting in high-stress levels

rules.say: Hard work can bring heavy pressure, stress and anxiety, which may affect your family, health and relationships. Take care that your knowledge does not turn into show-off.

rules.text: Uncontrolled sexual desire can be a weakness; pride; overspending leads to financial crises; tongue-tied with deep emotions; critical speech breeds resentment/betrayal; failures in love

source.quote: Splurging and spending very much on items and experiences may plunge your finances

rules.say: Take care of pride and overspending, which can lead to money troubles. Critical speech can breed resentment, you may struggle to voice deep feelings, and love may bring failures.

rules.text: Remedy/advice: keep adding value in job/business

source.quote: Destiny Number 3 demands value addition.

rules.say: Keep adding value in your job or business; this is your remedy.

rules.text: Rahu: mental power, intellect, practicality; reads between lines, reads motives; careful, plans ahead

source.quote: Destiny number 4 represents mental power, intellectual prowess, and practicality.

rules.say: Ruled by Rahu, you have strong mental power, intellect and practicality. You read between the lines, understand motives and plan ahead carefully.

rules.text: Often misunderstood; only a handful of friends after a certain age

source.quote: people often misunderstand you

rules.say: People often misunderstand you, and after a certain age you may have only a handful of friends.

rules.text: Rahu effects: big career plans end in something different; something always missing; disappointment in at least one area; job/field hopping; health concerns; physical labour unnoticed (brain over brawn); fluttering focus; disrupted masterplans; misses opportunities through scepticism; extra responsibilities

source.quote: Rahu brings disappointment in at least one facet of your life.

rules.say: Rahu can bring disappointment in at least one area of life, field-hopping, missed chances through doubt, and health concerns. Big plans may end differently, and your brain counts more than physical effort.

rules.text: Unconventional, revolutionary; ideas meet rejection

source.quote: the number 4 also represents unconventional ways, revolutions

rules.say: You are unconventional and revolutionary, though your ideas may meet rejection.

rules.text: Remedy/advice: use brain over brawn; criticise only when needed; do focus-building activities

source.quote: The more you rely and utilize on your brain over brawn, the faster you accomplish your goals.

rules.say: Use your brain more than physical effort, criticise only when needed, and do activities that build your focus.

rules.text: Mercury: intelligence, speed, change; resilient "rubber ball"; hard knocks up to age 28

source.quote: usually up until the age of 28, but you do not give in

rules.say: Ruled by Mercury, you are intelligent, quick and resilient like a rubber ball. Life may give you hard knocks until about 28, but you do not give in.

rules.text: Loves change; job/department/field switching; adaptable; childlike with children, mature with adults

source.quote: You like changes the most.

rules.say: You love change and may switch jobs, departments or fields. Adaptable by nature, you are childlike with children and mature with adults.

rules.text: Business skills and ideas; don't treat relationships as transactions; flood of ideas, write them down; bonds fast ("When in Rome")

source.quote: Destiny Number 5 rewards you with business skills and ideas.

rules.say: You have strong business skills and a flood of ideas, so write them down, and you bond quickly with people. Do not treat relationships as transactions.

rules.text: Kindness, wisdom, intuition, optimism, good luck; luck in romance; recognition; chance to live/work abroad; favours from relatives, government, authorities

source.quote: It also awards you the opportunity to live in a foreign country and work there.

rules.say: You are kind, wise, intuitive and optimistic, with luck in romance and recognition. You may get a chance to live or work abroad, and favours from relatives, government and authorities.

rules.text: Care: ideas misused -> gambling, fast money, manipulation; overuse of mind -> headaches, stomach issues; boredom in relationships

source.quote: you may find yourself indulging in gambling, fast-money-making ways

rules.say: Take care that your ideas are not misused for gambling, fast money or manipulation. Overusing your mind can bring headaches or stomach issues, and boredom can creep into relationships.

rules.text: "Most powerful number"; pioneers, inventors

source.quote: In numerology, 5 is considered the most powerful number.

rules.say: Your destiny number 5 is considered the most powerful number, linked with pioneers and inventors.

rules.text: Venus: luxury, beauty; attractive, fashionable; giver in love but not repaid equally; heartbreak more than once

source.quote: You may find your heart breaking more than once.

rules.say: Ruled by Venus, you love luxury, beauty and fashion. You give a lot in love but may not get the same back, and your heart may break more than once.

rules.text: Upscale taste; dependable carer for family (can feel endless); peace-lover, diplomatic, convincing

source.quote: You are a peace-lover and you always opt for a peaceful solution

rules.say: You have upscale taste and are a dependable carer for your family, though it can feel endless. You are peace-loving, diplomatic and convincing.

rules.text: Situations of unwanted sexual relationships / being taken advantage of sexually

source.quote: Destiny Number 6 will keep creating situations wherein you might find yourself getting desires to indulge in unwanted sexual relationships

rules.say: Your destiny number can create situations that tempt you into unwanted physical relationships, or where others try to take advantage of you, so take care.

rules.text: More favourable to women; look younger; if not married early, harder later; give partner space

source.quote: DN 6 is more favorable to you than it is to men.

rules.say: For women: this destiny number is more favourable to you than to men. If you do not marry early, it can get harder later, and giving your partner space helps.

rules.text: Sexual problems may come; take precautions

source.quote: If you are a man with Destiny Number 6, sexual problems may come your way.

rules.say: For men: this destiny number is linked with possible sexual problems, so take care and take precautions.

rules.text: Advice: buy luxury you need (not reckless); add beauty/luxury to your product or service; prefer assets over bank balance (savings low)

source.quote: Whatever you do, add beauty to it to make it look luxurious.

rules.say: Buy the luxury you need, not recklessly, and add beauty and luxury to your product or service. Your savings tend to be low, so prefer assets over bank balance.

rules.text: Ketu: spirituality, intuition; multiplies the qualities of the psychic number

source.quote: The greatest attribute of DN 7 is its power to enhance the qualities of your Psychic Number manyfold.

rules.say: Ruled by Ketu, the planet of spirituality and intuition, your destiny number multiplies the qualities of your psychic number.

rules.text: Adaptable; picks up good traits; everyone's favourite; intuition peaks late 20s to 40s; reads people from early 30s; best ideas from dreams/daydreams

source.quote: as you enter your late twenties, you become highly intuitive

rules.say: You adapt easily, pick up good traits and are everyone's favourite. Your intuition peaks from your late 20s to 40s, you read people well from your early 30s, and your best ideas come from dreams.

rules.text: Healer; careers in mental/physical healing; confusion leads to running away unless pushed

source.quote: Destiny Number 7 also makes you a healer.

rules.say: You are a healer and suit careers in mental or physical healing. Confusion can make you run away from things unless someone pushes you.

rules.text: Wisdom, good orator; humble yet lively; problem-solver; later spirituality/occult as career; recognition abroad

source.quote: Destiny Number 7 brings recognition in foreign countries.

rules.say: You are wise, humble yet lively, a good speaker and problem-solver. Later, spirituality or the occult can become your career, and recognition may come from abroad.

rules.text: Marital/romantic problems, possibility of affairs; marriage after 28 more likely successful

source.quote: if people get married after 28, they are more likely to enjoy a successful marriage

rules.say: Linked with problems in romance and marriage, including a chance of affairs. Marrying after 28 is more likely to bring a successful marriage.

rules.text: Sociable, attractive, intelligent, sometimes sentimental; career-oriented, assertive; bonds with women; seen as less romantic

source.quote: If you have been told that you are not as romantic, it's because of the DN 7.

rules.say: For women: you are sociable, intelligent, career-oriented and assertive, and bond well with women. You can be sentimental at times, though others may see you as less romantic.

rules.text: Successful in spirituality, mental health, teaching, dispute resolution, diplomacy

source.quote: DN 7 prolifically produces highly successful individuals in the field of spirituality

rules.say: You can do very well in spirituality, mental health work, teaching, resolving disputes and diplomacy.

rules.text: Saturn: discipline; heavy pressure before shining (coal to diamond); delays, obstacles, failures, humiliation; performs best under pressure

source.quote: like a chunk of coal put under pressure before it turns into a diamond

rules.say: Ruled by Saturn, you may face heavy pressure, delays, obstacles and even humiliation before you shine, like coal turning into a diamond. You perform best under pressure.

rules.text: Money and power; high positions; most wealth in early-to-mid thirties

source.quote: DN 8 blesses you with most of your share of wealth in your early thirties or mid-thirties.

rules.say: You are linked with money, power and high positions. Most of your wealth tends to come in your early to mid thirties.

rules.text: Losses through fraud, theft, embezzlement; caution with legal cases, motor accidents, early ageing

source.quote: DN 8 also brings financial losses through fraud, theft, embezzlement, and swindling.

rules.text: Occult inclination; more spiritual = better results; may lose faith; temptation to intoxication after disappointment

source.quote: the more spiritual you get, the better the results in your life

rules.say: You lean towards the occult, and the more spiritual you are, the better your results. After disappointment you may lose faith or feel tempted by intoxication, so take care.

rules.text: Solitude; problems, rejection as companions; romance weak; turbulent marriage, possible separation/divorce

source.quote: turbulent married life which sometimes leads to separation and even divorce

rules.say: Linked with solitude, rejection and weak romance, and a turbulent marriage that can lead to separation or divorce. Take extra care in your relationships.

rules.text: Inherits/accumulates property that may face disputes; real estate later the safest earning; right partner delayed but found; turbulence in marriage not from her side; stronger faith after marriage

source.quote: You would probably inherit or accumulate property or estate.

rules.say: For women: you may inherit or build property, though disputes can arise, and real estate later becomes your safest income. The right partner may come late, and marriage troubles are not from your side.

rules.text: May not respect spouse as deserved; main cause of turbulent marriage

source.quote: it will likely make you not respect your partner or spouse the way they deserve it

rules.say: For men: this number can make you not respect your spouse as they deserve, which may be the main cause of a turbulent marriage, so take care to give due respect.

rules.text: Advice: avoid bad habits, work smart; big risks brought sudden failure; remove greed; vigilance in legal matters; great planner; work with people friendly to your destiny and psychic numbers

source.quote: Uproot greed from your endeavors, and you would find the key to success.

rules.say: Avoid bad habits, work smart and remove greed, as big risks can bring sudden failure. Stay alert in legal matters, plan well, and work with people whose numbers are friendly to yours.

rules.text: Endurance; innovators, social reformers, wealth creators

source.quote: It blesses the world with innovators, social reformers

rules.say: Your number gives endurance and is linked with innovators, social reformers and wealth creators.

rules.text: Mars: energy, passion; 9 x any number reduces to 9 (36 -> 9); magnifies the psychic number; if psychic is not friendly with 9, complications

source.quote: If the Psychic number is not friendly with it, that may lead to several complications in life.

rules.say: Ruled by Mars, you have energy and passion, and 9 magnifies your psychic number. If your psychic number is not friendly with 9, it can bring complications in life.

rules.text: Complications in life (computable via chart 3.2: 9's friends are 1,3,5; enemies 2,4)

source.quote: magnifies the importance of the Physic Number

rules.say: Destiny number 9 magnifies the effect of your birth number, and as your birth number is not a friend of 9, this can bring complications in life.

rules.text: Very energetic; rest makes them restless; channel energy via physical/mental activity, meditation

source.quote: getting a great deal of rest makes you restless

rules.say: You are very energetic, and too much rest makes you restless. Channel your energy through physical or mental activity and meditation.

rules.text: Inner voice is best asset; humanitarian; nature/animal lover; loves beauty, art, knowledge

source.quote: You would find your best asset is the inner voice

rules.say: Your inner voice is your best asset. You are humanitarian, love nature and animals, and love beauty, art and knowledge.

rules.text: Passionate lover, "zero or a hundred"; revenge if cheated

source.quote: you would want to be either zero or a hundred

rules.say: You are a passionate lover, 'zero or a hundred', with no middle ground. If cheated, you may seek revenge.

rules.text: Natural teacher, spiritual teacher

source.quote: You would find you are a natural at teaching.

rules.say: You are a natural teacher, and can be a spiritual teacher too.

rules.text: Anger over small matters, revengeful, quarrelsome; vivid imagination can create worrying images; straightforward

source.quote: It causes anger, sometimes over small matters.

rules.say: You are straightforward but can get angry over small matters, quarrel or seek revenge, so take care. Your vivid imagination can also create worrying pictures in your mind.

rules.text: Philanthropists, humanitarians, artists

source.quote: Destiny Number 9 has produced great philanthropists

rules.say: Your number has produced great philanthropists, humanitarians and artists.
